context: Two teens trade tips before final-week exams
purpose: Teach: いたる/現われ/手助け/めざし/暖房/目前/５つ/反動

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験を目前にして、もう全然集中できない。
lines.en: With exams right in front of us, I can't focus at all.
lines.style: anxious teenage girl venting before exams

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。寒すぎて頭回らないから、暖房もうちょい強くしていい?
lines.en: I get it. It's too cold to think, can I turn the heater up a bit?
lines.style: casual teen boy, practical and relaxed tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: どうぞ。私、合格をめざし努力してきたのに、最近やばい症状が現われてきて……
lines.en: Go ahead. I've been working hard aiming to pass, but lately bad symptoms have been showing up.
lines.style: vulnerable teen girl confessing real worry

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 落ち着けって。俺の作戦、聞く?英単語を覚えるコツが５つあるんだ。
lines.en: Calm down. Wanna hear my strategy? I've got five tricks for memorizing English words.
lines.style: encouraging teen boy switching to mentor mode

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それ手助けしてほしい。お願い、教えて。
lines.en: Whoa, I'd love that help. Please, tell me.
lines.style: eager teen girl, leaning in with hope

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: まず、徹夜はやめろ。直前に詰め込むと、本番で反動が来て頭真っ白になるぞ。
lines.en: First, no all-nighters. Cramming last minute backfires and your mind blanks out during the test.
lines.style: teen boy giving firm older-brother advice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。じゃあ事ここにいたるまで放置してた試験範囲全部、一気に復習するのは無理ってこと?
lines.en: I see. So cramming the whole exam scope I'd left alone until things got this bad is a no-go?
lines.style: thoughtful teen girl processing the advice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: そう。範囲を絞れ。合格は目前だ、最後まで一緒に頑張ろう。
lines.en: Exactly. Narrow your scope. Passing is right ahead of us — let's push through together.
lines.style: supportive teen boy, warm and determined
